introHtml: Cotton poly turtlenecks combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them a practical choice for uniforms, corporate gifts, or team apparel. The blend resists shrinking and wrinkling, so your logo stays crisp through repeated washes. Ideal for cooler months or climate-controlled offices, these turtlenecks offer a professional look that employees will actually wear.
